p015.lead: From the system to the superuniverse, from nebulae to the supreme tribunals: a portrait of the structure and government of the seven superuniverses, the creations of time to which we belong.

p015.foot.text: Presented by a Universal Censor hailing from Uversa

p015.s0.h: Introduction — Seven Spokes on a Gigantic Wheel
p015.s0.b0: If Paper 14 shows us the perfect central universe, Paper 15 steps outside it into the **creations of time** where we actually live. The presenter, a Universal Censor from Uversa, likens the grand universe to one gigantic wheel. The hub is the Isle of Paradise, the seven spokes are the radiations of the Seven Master Spirits, and the rim is the outer regions of the grand universe.
p015.s0.b1: The same universe looks different depending on where one stands. To the Father the universes are virtually nonexistent, because he is the Father of persons and deals with persons. To the Son and the Spirit the universe is divided into local universes ruled by the Creator Sons and the Creative Spirits. And to the Paradise Trinity there are, outside Havona, just seven superuniverses.
p015.s0.b3: There is a reason the paper begins with physical structure. Only when we first understand the structure of space rightly can we grasp the meaning of the marvelous organization built upon it for spiritual government and for the advancement of will creatures.
p015.s1.h: I. The Superuniverse Space Level — Not an Uncharted Plunge
p015.s1.b0: Judged by short human records, our universe seems to be on one long, uncharted plunge into new space. But according to the records of Uversa, the seven superuniverses swing in an orderly way around Paradise and Havona along a great ellipse. Our local universe follows a well-understood counterclockwise course, and it is now passing through the very same space that its predecessors traversed ages ago.
p015.s1.b2: Orvonton not long ago turned the southeastern bend and is now moving along the long, comparatively straight northern path. Urantia belongs to a system well out toward the borderland of its local universe, and that local universe is traversing the periphery of Orvonton. Even on a cosmic scale, our lives are not aimless drifting but a journey along a charted course.
p015.s2.h: II. Organization of the Superuniverses — From System to Grand Universe
p015.s2.b0: Only the Universal Father knows the location and actual number of the inhabited worlds, and he calls them all by name and number. The figures the presenter gives are approximations meant to convey the immensity of creation. The grand universe is organized in administrative units built up by hundreds.

p015.s3.h: III. The Superuniverse of Orvonton — Our Home Seen from Within the Milky Way
p015.s3.b0: Practically all the stars visible to the naked eye from Urantia belong to Orvonton, the seventh superuniverse. The Milky Way is the central nucleus of Orvonton, and when we gaze through its region of greatest density, we are looking toward the residential universe and the center of all things. The rotational center of our minor sector lies in the star cloud of Sagittarius, and the nucleus of our solar system’s physical system is the center of the onetime Andronover nebula.
p015.s3.b1: The confusion of star observers arises from seven layered revolutions, from Urantia’s orbit around the sun to the swing of Orvonton and the other superuniverses around Paradise. The paths of the planet and the counterclockwise motion of Orvonton are inherent in origin, while the motions in between are of composite origin, produced in part by the purposeful action of the force organizers.
p015.s4.h: IV–VI. Nebulae, Space Bodies, and the Spheres of Space
p015.s4.b0: Universe formation begins with nebulae. The Paradise force organizers transmute space potency into primordial force and start tremendous cyclones of force that become nebulae. When energy reaches gravity-responding levels, the power directors establish circuits. Each local universe, regardless of nebular relationship, embraces exactly one one-hundred-thousandth of the total energy of its superuniverse, because energy is universally distributed.
p015.s4.b2: Suns and planets arise in ten principal ways, among them concentric contraction rings, whirled stars, gravity-explosion planets, centrifugal daughters, cumulative spheres, and collisional spheres; our own solar system arose by gravity explosion. Apart from the architectural spheres, all space bodies have an evolutionary origin. God’s creative acts, in other words, have unfolded by a time-space technique through the work of many intelligences.
p015.s4.b3: Several observations about the spheres stand out. The dark islands of space act as balance wheels that hold neighboring systems and keep them from destruction. A comet’s tail shows that light has weight and is a real substance. In our superuniverse not one cool planet in forty is habitable by beings of our order, and Urantia, in size, density, and location, is in many respects ideal for human habitation.
p015.s5.h: VII. The Architectural Spheres — Worlds That Become Steps of the Ascent
p015.s5.b0: The headquarters world of each government is an architectural sphere built for its special purpose. It has a sun that gives light without heat and is independently lighted and heated. All headquarters worlds are paradisiacal, increasing in size, beauty, and glory from Jerusem to the central Isle, and each is surrounded by training worlds for ascenders.

p015.s5.b3: It is interesting to learn that the word “heaven,” as used on Urantia, has sometimes meant these seven mansion worlds. And ascending creatures, even as they advance into spiritual realms, never lose their appreciation for their former levels of existence. Growth does not mean discarding the stages we have passed through but carrying them with us as we rise.
p015.s6.h: VIII–IX. Energy Control and Regulation; Circuits of the Superuniverses
p015.s6.b0: Superuniverse headquarters function as power-energy regulators, and power centers and physical controllers maintain the balance of energy. When mass becomes overaggregated, collisions occur that turn matter back into energy and restore equilibrium. The farther one goes from Paradise, the harder prediction becomes, and that unpredictability reveals the presence of the Absolutes and the experiential Deities.
p015.s6.b2: Besides the four presence circuits of Paradise, two divisions of circuits function in superuniverse space: the superuniverse circuits and the local universe circuits. Closest to us are the local universe circuits: the Spirit of Truth, the circuit of the Universe Mother Spirit, and the intelligence-ministry circuit that includes the adjutant mind-spirits.

p015.s6.b4: Nebadon does not yet meet either requirement. Yet the superuniverse government does not abandon us. Just as the presenter himself came to Urantia directly from Uversa, its members are dispatched on special missions to help, and he says they desire to see our universe qualified for full admission into the superuniverse family.
p015.s7.h: X–XIII. Superuniverse Government — Rulers, Assembly, Tribunals, and Sector Governments
p015.s7.b0: Each superuniverse is presided over by three Ancients of Days. The executive branch consists of seven groups: the first four are of Trinity origin, while the last three are **glorified ascendant mortals** who rose from the evolutionary worlds and were embraced by the Trinity.

p015.s7.b2: While the executive branch comes from the realms of perfection, the legislative assembly springs from the flowering of the evolutionary universes. The representatives in the seven houses on Uversa are chosen from ascending graduates of Orvonton who are accredited for transport to Havona. Remarkably, in the whole history of Orvonton there has never been a disagreement between the executives and the assembly.
p015.s7.b4: In judgment, too, the principle is clear. The Sons of the local universes can decree the survival of mortals, but only the Ancients of Days may sit in judgment on the issues of eternal life and death, such as the extinction of will creatures. The major and minor sector governments deal with intellectual status and physical co-ordination, and the reports of the Trinity observers pass from the constellations up to the superuniverse headquarters.
p015.s8.h: XIV. Purposes of the Seven Superuniverses — Orvonton, a Universe of Love and Mercy
p015.s8.b0: Each of the seven superuniverses gives fullest expression to one of the seven purposes of evolution. Our own Orvonton is known for its lavish bestowal of merciful ministry to mortals. Here justice is tempered by mercy and power is conditioned by patience.

p015.s9.b0: Paper 15 is full of numbers and administrative units, yet its conclusion is warm. Urantia, one of seven trillion worlds, is cared for as if it were the only one. And at the heart of that vast government, ascendant mortals who rose from evolutionary worlds like ours take part in judgment and legislation. Our journey lies along a charted course, and its end leads toward Havona.

p015.s9.b2: Paper 16 turns to the Seven Master Spirits, introduced in this paper as the seven spokes of the wheel. Once we know who the Seventh Master Spirit is, the one who presides over our superuniverse from Paradise, we will see more clearly where Orvonton’s merciful character comes from.
p016.lead: The Seven Master Spirits, born of the seven associative possibilities of Deity: the paper on those who govern the superuniverses, bestow the cosmic mind, and leave their stamp on our personalities.

p016.foot.text: Sponsored by a Universal Censor from Uversa

p016.s0.h: Introduction — Why the Universe Is Divided into Seven
p016.s0.b0: When Paper 15 pictured the grand universe as a wheel, its seven spokes were the radiations of the Seven Master Spirits. Paper 16 explains who these Master Spirits are. They are the primary personalities of the Infinite Spirit, and there are seven of them because there are exactly seven associative possibilities inherent in the three Deities, the Father, the Son, and the Spirit.
p016.s0.b2: In spirit character the Seven Spirits are as one, but in every other aspect of identity they are very unlike, and their differences condition the character of the seven superuniverses. Each Master Spirit keeps a force-focal headquarters on the periphery of Paradise, always positioned opposite the superuniverse it supervises.
p016.s1.h: I–II. Relation to Triune Deity; Relation to the Infinite Spirit
p016.s1.b0: If the threefold personalization of Deity as Father, Son, and Spirit is the absolute inevitability, the appearance of the Seven Master Spirits is the subabsolute inevitability. To create universes duly expressive of threefold Deity, seven associative expressions were necessary. Through the Seven Master Spirits the Father, the Son, the Spirit, or any dual association can function, but not the Trinity.
p016.s1.b1: Yet when the Seven Spirits vacate their individual seats and assemble about the Conjoint Actor on Paradise, they collectively represent the functional power, wisdom, and authority of the Trinity to the evolving universes. They then encompass the functional domain of the Supreme-Ultimate.
p016.s1.b2: Their relation to the Infinite Spirit is summed up in an order of divine communication. The Father speaks through the Son; the Father and the Son act through the Infinite Spirit; and outside Paradise and Havona the Infinite Spirit speaks by the voices of the Seven Master Spirits. This is why the spirit presence of the Third Source and Center on our world is conditioned by the unique nature of the Master Spirit who supervises Orvonton.
p016.s1.b4: The Master Spirits are collectively endowed with the supreme-ultimate attributes of the Infinite Spirit. Omnipotence, omniscience, and omnipresence are disclosed only collectively; as individuals, each is limited to the superuniverse he supervises.
p016.s2.h: III. Identity and Diversity of the Master Spirits — Seven Faces of the Spirit
p016.s2.b0: The Master Spirits have names, but the paper introduces them by number. Each expresses one of the seven associations of Deity and speaks for that association in their councils.

p016.s2.b2: The most important for us is Master Spirit Number Seven. He is a portrait of Father, Son, and Spirit in equal proportions, and because he is personally nonfunctional with regard to the Trinity, he can function personally for the Supreme Being. In the present age, when the person of the Supreme cannot be contacted, he functions in the place of God for ascending creatures.
p016.s2.b4: The statement that his administration of Orvonton discloses the symmetry of the co-ordinate blending of the natures of Father, Son, and Spirit fits well with the merciful character of Orvonton we saw in Paper 15. Our superuniverse lives under a Spirit of balance who leans toward no single side.
p016.s3.h: IV. Attributes and Functions of the Master Spirits — “The Seven Spirits of God”
p016.s3.b0: The Seven Master Spirits are the full representation of the Infinite Spirit to the evolutionary universes and function on all levels of reality except the absolute. They are the creators of the Universe Power Directors, and they materially assist the Creator Sons in organizing the local universes. Above all, combining matter and spirit to produce morontia substance and morontia mind is their great contribution to the plan of man’s Paradise ascent.
p016.s3.b2: The presenter considers it highly probable that the Master Spirit of Orvonton has a decided influence on the life initiation of the Life Carriers, the activation of the adjutant mind-spirits, the bestowal of the Holy Spirit and the Spirit of Truth, and the mechanism of reflectivity. On the other hand, there are two realms with which they have nothing whatever to do: the bestowal and ministry of the Thought Adjusters, and the functions of the Unqualified Absolute. The Adjuster within us belongs to the Father alone.
p016.s4.h: V. Relation to Creatures — The Indelible Stamp of Origin
p016.s4.b0: Every universe enjoys the united counsel and wisdom of all Seven Master Spirits, but receives the personal touch and tinge of only one. The Master Spirits do not directly invade the minds of mortals; they influence us through the ministry of the local universe Creative Spirit. And our Creative Mother Spirit is, in nature and character, quite like the Master Spirit of Orvonton.
p016.s4.b2: This stamp is not erased even by the long training of Havona and the culture of Paradise. That is why, in the Corps of the Finality, when a complete relationship to the evolutionary creation is to be portrayed, a group of seven finaliters is assembled, one from each superuniverse. Diversity is not a flaw to be removed but a share that completes the whole.
p016.s5.h: VI. The Cosmic Mind — The Roots of Science, Morality, and Religion
p016.s5.b0: The Master Spirits are the sevenfold source of the cosmic mind. On Urantia we live under the immediate influence of the Creative Spirit of Nebadon, yet the basic reactions of all creature mind come from the Master Spirits. The cosmic mind explains why the minds of different people sometimes reach astonishing agreement. It also has a quality of “reality response” that saves will creatures from becoming helpless victims of the unexamined assumptions of science, philosophy, and religion.

p016.s5.b2: When these three insights are unified, they produce a strong character in which factual science, moral philosophy, and genuine religious experience are joined. The presenter regrets that so few on Urantia take delight in courageous and independent cosmic thinking, and he sums up how the whole of human life serves these endowments.
p016.s6.h: VII. Morals, Virtue, and Personality — Beings Who Look Before They Leap
p016.s6.b0: What distinguishes man from the animals is not so much intelligence as his moral and religious nature. An animal ordinarily learns only by leaping, but a personality can look before it leaps. Intelligence can choose among means, but a moral being judges the worth of the ends themselves.
p016.s6.b2: Virtue is realized by consistently choosing good rather than evil, and it also requires a sense of proportion to weigh the lesser against the greater. Morality is never advanced by law or by force; it spreads by the “contagion” of contact with morally fragrant persons. And supreme virtue is wholeheartedly to choose to do the will of the Father in heaven.
p016.s7.h: VIII–IX. Urantia Personality; Reality of Human Consciousness
p016.s7.b0: Personality is a unique gift of the Father, independent of and antecedent to the bestowal of the Adjuster. Adjusters are identical in nature, but personality is diverse, original, and exclusive. However much the body and mind may change, personality is what lets us recognize a person as the one we knew. Creature personality is distinguished by self-consciousness and relative free will.

rows: Wholehearted devotion to doing the Father’s will
The sincere pursuit of divine values and wholehearted love of the divine Value-Giver

p016.s7.b2: The ninth section contrasts God-consciousness with social consciousness. We can be more certain of the presence of God within us than of the reality of a fellow being, and social consciousness, being a cultural development, is unstable. Civilizations come and go, but science, morality, and religion always survive the crash. Unselfishness, moreover, does not arise on its own; it comes from knowing God.
p016.s7.b4: In the end, self-consciousness is essentially communal. Because we are conscious of God as our Creator Father, we become conscious of other people as our brothers. The paper closes by giving three reasons for worship: because he is, because he is in us, and because we are in him.
p016.s8.b0: Paper 16 begins with seven Spirits on high and comes down to the structure of our minds and the virtues of everyday life. The stamp left by the Master Spirit of Orvonton becomes part of our individuality forever, and the cosmic mind they bestow gives rise to the insights of science, morality, and worship. To weave those insights into one and choose the Father’s will is both the purpose of personality and the supreme virtue.

p016.s8.b2: Paper 17 continues with the seven groups of Supreme Spirits who work with the Seven Master Spirits. Keeping in mind the principle of seven met in this paper, we will readily understand why universe administration is woven in sevens throughout.
p017.lead: From the Seven Master Spirits on Paradise to the adjutant spirits of mortal mind: the seven functional families of the Infinite Spirit that bind the grand universe together.

p017.foot.text: Presented by a Divine Counselor of Uversa

p017.s0.h: Introduction — A Chain of Spirit from Top to Bottom
p017.s0.b0: If Paper 16 introduced the Seven Master Spirits, Paper 17 widens the view to the larger family they head. The **seven Supreme Spirit groups** described here are the co-ordinating directors of the seven-segmented administration of the grand universe. All belong to the functional family of the Infinite Spirit, but by origin they fall into two branches. The first three groups are usually classed as children of the Paradise Trinity; the remaining four are brought into being by the creative acts of the Infinite Spirit and his associates.

p017.s0.b2: The reach of these seven orders is astonishing. It begins with the Master Spirits on the periphery of the eternal Isle and runs through the Paradise satellites of the Spirit, the Havona circuits, the superuniverse governments, and the local universes, all the way down to the lowly service of the adjutants bestowed upon evolutionary minds. This paper therefore tells us that even the smallest stirrings deep within our own minds touch the outermost edge of a vast spiritual order that stretches back to Paradise.
p017.s0.b4: The Master Spirits do some things personally, but much of their work they carry out through associates. In executive matters they act in the persons of the Supreme Executives; in the central universe they work through the Spirits of the Circuits; in the superuniverses they reveal themselves through the Reflective Spirits and the Image Aids. Because they do not directly contact universe administration below the courts of the Ancients of Days, the function of the Master Spirit of Orvonton in our local universe is discharged by the Creative Mother Spirit resident on Salvington.
p017.s1.h: I. The Seven Supreme Executives — The Board of Managing Directors
p017.s1.b0: The Supreme Executives are a group of seven beings trinitized by the Father, Son, and Spirit. They direct the executive headquarters of the Master Spirits on the seven Paradise satellites of the Infinite Spirit. Executive Number One looks after superuniverse number one alone, and so on to Executive Number Seven, who devotes himself to the seventh superuniverse. The name of that seventh sphere is Orvonton; in fact, the superuniverses were named after these satellites.
p017.s1.b2: Yet this board does not make policy. Its members carry out the plans of divinity promulgated by the Master Spirits, and they do not interfere with the rule of the Ancients of Days or the sovereignty of the Creator Sons. They have no presiding head either; each time they meet, they choose one of their number to preside. That beings of perfect divinity should co-operate so humbly shows that true authority lies less in domination than in service and co-ordination.
p017.s1.b4: Each executive has two advisory cabinets. Their make-up shows that ascending mortals are never left out of universe management: in all matters affecting the ascenders of time, mortals who have attained Paradise give their counsel directly.

p017.s1.b6: These satellites also host great conclaves, reunions that recall the struggles and triumphs of the ascendant career, and once in each Paradise millennium the seven executives go to Paradise to send greeting and well-wishing to the intelligent hosts of creation. It is striking that a great center of administration is at the same time a place of remembrance and celebration.
p017.s2.b0: The Reflective Spirits number forty-nine. They were created seven at a time, each creative episode effected by a liaison of the Paradise Trinity and one of the Seven Master Spirits. When the forty-ninth Reflective Spirit had personalized and the cycle was complete, a new and far-reaching reaction occurred in the Deity Absolute, which culminated in the personalization of **Majeston**, the reflectivity chief.
p017.s2.b2: The creation of Majeston was the first supreme creative act of the Supreme Being. The Supreme willed it, but the response of the Deity Absolute went far beyond what was intended or foreseen. On this basis the revelators confess that they stand in awe of the possibility that, as the Supreme and the Ultimate reach new levels, undreamed of beings may yet appear. The universe is not a finished machine; it remains a place open to newness that surprises even Deity.
p017.s3.h: III–IV. The Reflective Spirits and the Reflective Image Aids — The Living Memory of the Universe
p017.s3.b0: Each of the seven creative episodes produced a type of being resembling its coancestral Master Spirit. The Reflective Spirits therefore reflect in various ways the seven possible combinations of the divinity characteristics of the three Deities, and one of each type is assigned to every superuniverse headquarters. Their names are part of one of the seven universal mysteries of the secret spheres of Paradise.
p017.s3.b1: Curiously, neither the Master Spirits nor the Paradise Deities disclose the powers of reflectivity just as these spirits manifest them; yet they are the creators of these gifted beings. The passage shows that creatures can bring to flower, in a new form, what they have received from their Creator.
p017.s3.b3: The Reflective Spirits are not merely transmitting agents; they are retentive personalities as well. Everything of true spiritual value is registered in duplicate. This means that our good deeds and sincere strivings do not vanish; they are kept in the minds of living personalities.
p017.s3.b5: Reflectivity is also the news-gathering and decree-disseminating mechanism of all creation, and it works constantly rather than periodically like the broadcasts. It may look automatic, but the revelator insists that it is all very personal and intelligent, the fruit of perfect personality co-operation. Behind the precision of the universe stands not a machine but persons.
p017.s3.b6: In each superuniverse the Reflective Spirits created their own **Reflective Image Aids**, true likenesses of themselves. An Image Aid reproduces its Reflective Mother Spirit perfectly, minus the attribute of reflectivity, and serves as the Spirit’s personal voice to the courts of the Ancients of Days. But the Image Aids are devoid of will and do not choose, and so ascending mortals will not personally contact them even in the schools of Uversa.
p017.s4.h: V. The Seven Spirits of the Circuits — Impersonal Companions of Havona
p017.s4.b0: The Seven Spirits of the Circuits are the collective offspring of the Seven Master Spirits, impersonal representatives who each permeate one of the seven circuits of Havona. Where the Master Spirits give diversified individuality to the superuniverses, through these uniform Circuit Spirits they provide unified supervision for the central universe. The Circuit Spirits contact Havona sojourners through their personal offspring, the tertiary supernaphim.
p017.s4.b1: The paper sets the Circuit Spirits beside the Thought Adjusters. Both are impersonal and both consort with mind, but the Circuit Spirits never become a permanent part of Havona personalities, whereas the Adjuster is destined to become one with the mortal. The comparison throws into relief how remarkable a gift the mortals of time have received.

p017.s4.b3: As we pass from circuit to circuit in Havona we will enjoy their spiritual influence and recognize their impersonal presence, but we will not be able to hold personal communion with them.
p017.s5.h: VI–VII. The Local Universe Creative Spirits and the Adjutant Mind-Spirits
p017.s5.b0: The sixth group, the local universe Creative Spirits, has the most moving career in the paper. The revelators know six phases in the life of a Mother Spirit and speculate about a seventh. A potential that arises within the Infinite Spirit when a Creator Son is born is differentiated through the Master Spirit’s “⟦Q 17:6.5⟧prayer of identification⟦/Q⟧,” becomes a true person at the time of life creation, and at last is raised to cosovereignty.

p017.s5.b3: This story is a model of divine partnership. The union the Father acknowledges carries the two through the long and arduous period of material organization, and after victory it flowers into the recognition of equality. The picture of two co-operating persons growing together is worth holding up to our own relationships.
p017.s5.b4: The seventh and last group, the adjutant mind-spirits, is the sevenfold mind bestowal that a Mother Spirit gives to living creatures once she attains the status of personality prerogatives. The detailed account is left for the story of Nebadon, but within the design of this paper the point is clear: the very foundation of our minds is already linked to the last place in the line of the seven Supreme Spirit groups.
p017.s6.h: VIII. Functions of the Supreme Spirits — Unifying the Descending Administration
p017.s6.b0: The seven Supreme Spirit groups form the nucleus of the functional family of the Third Source and Center. Their domain extends from the presence of the Trinity on Paradise to the functioning of mind on the planets of space, and so they unify the descending levels of administration. Together with the Infinite Mother Spirit they are also the immediate creators of nearly every order of ministering spirits.

head: Creator
Ministering spirits created
rows: The Seven Spirits of the Circuits
The seconaphim of the superuniverse services
The angelic orders of that local creation

p017.s6.b3: The paper closes by summing up five roles of the Master Spirits, through which they co-ordinate the activities of God the Sevenfold. It then looks ahead: the functional unity of the Conjoint Actor now disclosed in the Master Spirits will, in the perfected superuniverses of the future, be inseparable from the experiential sovereignty of the Supreme.

head: Viewpoint
Role of the Seven Master Spirits
rows: They near-equivalate to the divinity level of the Trinity
They exhaust the primary associable possibilities of triune Deity
As representatives of the Conjoint Actor
Repositories of the spirit-mind-power sovereignty the Supreme does not yet personally exercise
They synchronize the superuniverse governments with Majeston
In individualizing the local universe Divine Ministers
They contribute to the last level of God the Sevenfold

p017.s7.b0: Paper 17 is an administrative paper full of unfamiliar names, but a clear message runs beneath it. The grand universe is joined from top to bottom by an unbroken chain of spirit. Each link of that chain moves by co-ordination and service rather than domination. And everything of spiritual value is preserved as a living record.

head: Practice
The teaching behind it
rows: Remember that even my small inner choices are joined to a great order
The domain of the Supreme Spirits reaches to the functioning of mortal mind
Be someone who co-ordinates rather than contends in my own place
The Supreme Executives co-operate without a presiding head
Live sincerely even when no one sees
Spiritual values are preserved as living records
Honor those I work with as equal partners
The Creator Son acknowledges the Mother Spirit as his equal

p017.s7.b2: Paper 18 turns next to the trinitized beings glimpsed in this paper, the Supreme Trinity Personalities. If we keep in mind the picture of the Infinite Spirit’s family drawn here, it becomes much easier to follow how the government of the grand universe is organized in the papers that follow.
p018.lead: From Paradise to the constellation capitals: the seven orders of the “Days” who carry the justice and wisdom of the Trinity throughout the grand universe.

p018.foot.text: Presented by a Divine Counselor of Uversa

p018.s0.h: Introduction — A Chain of Administration That Never Fails
p018.s0.b0: If Paper 17 showed us the functional family of the Infinite Spirit, Paper 18 introduces the administrators made directly by the Paradise Trinity. The **Supreme Trinity Personalities** are all designed for specific service, and they serve with perfection of technique and finality of devotion. Their numbers are definite and final; no more are being personalized.

head: Order
Number
Place of service
Role
rows: Seventy (ten on each of seven worlds)
The seven Paradise spheres of the Father
Administrators of the personal relations of the Deities with creatures
Rulers of the superuniverses (three to each)
Vicegerents of the Ancients of Days

p018.s0.b2: These seven orders form an interrelated line of administrative perfection reaching from the Paradise spheres of the Father to the capitals of the local universe constellations. They represent the policies and the justice of the Trinity, and they are at the same time its executive judgment.
p018.s0.b4: For us who live amid the confusion of an evolutionary world, this is a great comfort. Above the universes of time, where rebellion and error do occur, rests a framework of justice and wisdom that never wavers. Yet even these beings, in the realms of experience, have gained added equipment for cosmic service with the passing of time.
p018.s1.h: I. The Trinitized Secrets of Supremacy — The Privacy of Personality Respected
p018.s1.b0: The seven worlds of the innermost circuit of the Paradise satellites, the personal circuit of the Universal Father, are governed by seventy Secrets of Supremacy, ten to each world. The work of each world is divided into seven major departments, each headed by one of the ten; the remaining three represent the Father, the Son, and the Spirit. Each group resembles the Deity or Deity association characteristic of its world.
p018.s1.b1: Why is the work of these worlds secret? Because it concerns the intimate and personal contact of the Deities with the seven basic groupings of created beings. There are no arbitrary secrets in the approach to God, but the personal relationship of Deity with each creature is held sacred.
p018.s1.b4: This teaching sheds light on how we treat one another. The relationship between God and a single person is holy ground that no one else may casually judge or pry into. The revelator adds that these secret worlds ever remain a test of loyalty, even to beings of high universe attainment.
p018.s2.h: II. The Eternals of Days — Original Rulers of Havona’s Billion Worlds
p018.s2.b0: Each of the billion worlds of Havona has one Eternal of Days. They have ruled their worlds forever, without rotation or reassignment, and they are visible to all will creatures in their domains. They are close of kin to the Ancients of Days and are their divine equals.
p018.s2.b1: What stands out is their creativity. Each has developed his sphere according to his own personal ideas and ideals, and though they visit one another, they never imitate. So every Havona world is a place of everlasting beauty, wholly unlike any other. It is a fine example of how perfection does not mean uniformity.
p018.s2.b3: This section also offers a small correction about the direction of ascent. We speak of going “up” to Paradise, but it would be more correct to say that the goal of ascension lies “inward.” The journey of faith, too, is in the end less a climb to outward heights than a journey of depth toward the center.
p018.s3.h: III. The Ancients of Days — Rulers of the Superuniverses
p018.s3.b0: The twenty-one Ancients of Days were all trinitized at the same time, and they stand at the very beginning of the personality records of the universe of universes; hence their name. They always govern the superuniverses in groups of three.
p018.s3.b1: They never personally leave their residential worlds, and they do not need to, for these worlds are the superuniverse focal points of the far-flung reflectivity system. The reflectivity service we met in Paper 17 thus becomes the practical instrument of superuniverse government. Their abodes lie at the point of spiritual polarity on the headquarters sphere, which is divided into seventy administrative sectors.

head: Comparison
The Seven Master Spirits
The Ancients of Days
rows: Basically identical, disclosing the unified nature of the Trinity
Administrative uniformity and the harmony of the whole

p018.s3.b3: They are the most powerful of all the direct rulers of the time-space creations. They alone are invested with final executive judgment concerning the eternal extinction of will creatures, and all three must participate in such decrees. That the eternal destiny of a single being is handled with such care shows how fair and solemn God’s justice is.
p018.s3.b4: Yet they have not earned their right to rule through experience. They are therefore destined one day to be superseded by the Supreme Being, the experiential sovereign, and to become his vicegerents. Just as a Creator Son earns the sovereignty of his local universe by experience, so the Supreme is achieving the sovereignty of the seven superuniverses through experiential service.
p018.s4.h: IV–V. The Perfections of Days and the Recents of Days — Teachers of the Ascenders
p018.s4.b0: The two hundred and ten Perfections of Days preside, three at a time, over the ten major sectors of each superuniverse. They are peculiarly perfect in the mastery of administrative details, hence their name. The revelator admits how hard it is to translate the names of spiritual beings into our language, and says they try to choose names that are clear to us and yet somewhat representative of the original.
p018.s4.b1: The twenty-one thousand Recents of Days are the youngest of the superuniverse directors and govern the minor sectors in groups of three. They are co-ordinate in nature with the Perfections of Days but subordinate in authority. The minor sector governments deal largely with physical problems, and their spheres are the headquarters of the Master Physical Controllers.
p018.s4.b2: These two orders are very close to ascending mortals. We will pass through the hands of the three Recents of Days of Ensa, our minor sector, advance to the major sector of Splandon, and see all thirty Perfections of Days of Orvonton before we reach Uversa. Each stage of training has a distinct character.

head: Place of training
Character of the training
rows: The seven educational spheres of a minor sector
The seventy worlds around a major sector headquarters
The four hundred ninety university worlds of a superuniverse headquarters

p018.s4.b4: This sequence, from matter to intellect and from intellect to spirit, traces the natural path of growth. Moreover, nearly all the administrators of these governments served apprenticeships under the Eternals of Days in Havona. That even perfect beings learn and are trained reminds us that learning is the basic pattern of an eternal career.
p018.s4.b6: The three Recents of Days are seldom together on their capital. One may be conferring with his major sector superiors or attending a Paradise conclave, and another may be away inspecting local universe headquarters. Yet at least one always remains on duty. This sense of responsibility, never leaving the post empty however busy things become, is a good example for anyone entrusted with even a small community.
p018.s5.h: VI–VII. The Unions of Days and the Faithfuls of Days — Counselors to the Local Universe
p018.s5.b0: The Trinity personalities of the order of “Days” do not administer below the level of the superuniverse governments. In the local universes they serve only as counselors. The Union of Days is the Trinity ambassador assigned to each local universe, and apart from his duties as observer he acts only at the request of the local authorities. He is an ex officio member of all primary councils, but he takes no part in the technical details of administration.
p018.s5.b1: He is called a “Union” because he co-ordinates the activities of all branches of universal government. He makes a threefold report, according to the nature of the matter.

head: Content of the report
Superiors who receive it
rows: Data of a physical and semi-intellectual nature
The Recents of Days of the minor sector
The Perfections of Days of the major sector
The Ancients of Days at the superuniverse capital

p018.s5.b3: A Creator Son of dual Deity origin rules the local universe, but at his side there is always a Paradise brother of Trinity origin. When the Creator Son is temporarily absent, the acting rulers are largely guided by the counsel of their Union of Days in their major decisions. The greater the authority, the more the universe provides a wise counselor close at hand.
p018.s5.b4: The Faithfuls of Days fill the same role for the Vorondadek Sons who rule the constellations. Their name comes from their supreme devotion and divine faithfulness to the constellations they serve. Their abodes are indeed modest compared with the homes of the Vorondadek rulers.
p018.s5.b6: The Trinity-origin regime stops with the constellations. The administration of the systems and inhabited worlds below them belongs wholly to beings native to the local universe. In other words, the affairs of our world are entrusted to beings who are close to us.
p018.s6.b0: Paper 18 shows how the order of the universe is joined from top to bottom by justice and wisdom. The beings of that order are perfect yet not uniform, powerful yet willing to step back as counselors, and so respectful of personality that they guard the relationship between God and each creature as a secret. And along our path of ascent we will actually meet them.

head: Practice
The teaching behind it
rows: Do not casually judge another person’s experience of faith
The Creators respect the privacy and sanctity of personality
Cultivate beauty in my own way instead of imitating others
The Eternals of Days are always and wholly original
Help when asked, and help without dominating
The Union of Days acts only at the request of the local authorities
Be faithful to the welfare of the community entrusted to me
The devotion of the Faithfuls of Days

p018.s6.b2: Paper 19 continues with other beings who also take origin in the Trinity, the Co-ordinate Trinity-Origin Beings. If we remember the system of the “Days” met in this paper, the larger picture of grand universe government will become much clearer.
p019.lead: Beings who are the very wisdom, counsel, and judgment of the Trinity, the secret Inspired Spirits, and the natives of Havona and Paradise.

p019.foot.text: Presented by a Divine Counselor of Uversa

p019.s0.h: Introduction — Another Family Born of the Trinity
p019.s0.b0: After the Supreme Trinity Personalities of Paper 18, Paper 19 introduces seven more groups of Trinity origin. The author is a Divine Counselor, and because he is describing his own order, the paper carries a special vividness. Except for the Teacher Sons and possibly the Inspired Spirits, these groups are of definite numbers, and their creation is a finished event.

head: Group
Number
Essential character
rows: Liaison beings of Trinity origin who serve as Sons
The wisdom of the Trinity itself
The counsel of the Trinity itself
The judgment of the Trinity itself
The perfect natives of the central universe

p019.s1.h: I. The Trinity Teacher Sons — and the Right Way to Approach Truth
p019.s1.b0: Of all the high personalities revealed to us, the Teacher Sons alone act in a dual capacity. They are of Trinity origin, yet in function they are devoted to the services of divine sonship, and so they bridge the gulf between Trinity- and dual-origin personalities. They are also the supreme co-ordinating personalities of Trinity origin.
p019.s1.b1: Here the author turns suddenly to a question of method. In so vast a universe there is great danger of the error of the circumscribed viewpoint and a segmentalized conception of reality. The human mind usually wants to begin with the simple and lower and climb to the higher, but that path reveals only origins and says little or nothing about divine destiny. True perspective comes only from studying **origin, history, and destiny** together.

head: Danger of approaching from below
What it means
rows: It may utterly fail to perceive the completed evolutionary goal
It distorts facts, perverts truth, and misconceives destinies
Knowing how a being became does not reveal what it now is
History alone fails to reveal future development, destiny

p019.s1.b4: This is why The Urantia Book begins at the Paradise Source and Center and journeys outward into time and space. The passage reveals the organizing principle of the whole book. The same wisdom applies to a personal life: I should not define myself only by where I came from; only when I also look at where I am called to go can I rightly understand who I am today.
p019.s2.h: II–IV. Wisdom, Counsel, and Judgment — Three Co-ordinate Orders of the Superuniverses
p019.s2.b0: The Perfectors of Wisdom, the Divine Counselors, and the Universal Censors all passed through the wisdom of Paradise and Havona and were then permanently assigned to the service of the Ancients of Days. What these three orders have in common is that they do not merely “reflect” something of the Trinity; they are that very thing.
p019.s2.b2: Yet even this perfect wisdom is not sufficient alone. Wisdom has two origins: the divine insight inherent in perfect beings, and the personal experience acquired by evolutionary creatures. So in superuniverse administration the Perfectors of Wisdom are always associated with ascendant personalities who have come up through the tribulations of experience. That the perfect and those who grew through hardship need each other shows how precious our experience is in the universe.
p019.s2.b3: These three orders are also the highest beings engaged in revealing truth to the planets. From initial-life worlds to worlds settled in light and life, they take part from time to time in service to ascending mortals. When we remember that the very paper we are reading is a fruit of such service, revelation feels less like a distant story and more like concrete care directed toward us.
p019.s2.b4: When the three orders work together they form the highest mobile advisory body. A tribunal of nine, one Perfector of Wisdom, seven Divine Counselors, and one Universal Censor, is called a fact-finding or truth-revealing tribunal, and in all the annals of the superuniverses its verdict has never been reversed.
p019.s2.b5: The author says that seven Divine Counselors in liaison with an evolutionary trio of a Mighty Messenger, One High in Authority, and One without Name and Number come nearest to uniting the human viewpoint with the divine attitude. Only the Paradise bestowal Sons, who are God and man, surpass this. That the place where God’s will and human circumstances meet is shown most fully in a bestowal Son invites us to think again about the life of Jesus.
p019.s2.b8: One Universal Censor is also stationed on each of the billion worlds of Havona. The other two orders have no permanent assignment there, and even the author does not altogether understand why the Censors do. He suspects they are there in anticipation of some future age in which the Havona population may partially change. The honesty of revelators who admit what they do not know runs all through this paper.
p019.s2.b9: The Censors are “⟦Q 19:4.5⟧universe totaling personalities⟦/Q⟧” who gather all testimony, wisdom, and counsel and reveal the true total of what has transpired. When a Censor has spoken, no one else may speak. The author confesses that the Censors seem to formulate new meanings and originate new values, and that even after allowing for all that is known, their verdicts cannot be predicted. They seem in some manner to be in liaison with the Deity Absolute.
p019.s2.b11: Together with the seven orders of Supreme Trinity Personalities, these three orders make up the ten groups called the Stationary Sons of the Trinity. Their numbers slightly exceed thirty-seven billion, and they uphold the administration, rule, counsel, and judgment of the universe.
p019.s3.h: V. Inspired Trinity Spirits — The Unseen Teachers
p019.s3.b0: The Inspired Trinity Spirits are one of the few wholly secret orders of beings. They cannot fully reveal themselves even to a Divine Counselor, whose origin is so near their own. They may be superpersonal spirits, and they act well-nigh independently of time and space. The author says their character can be deduced only from the results of their activities.
p019.s3.b1: The beings who can sense them are the Solitary Messengers, who detect their presence as unfailingly as a magnetic needle points to a pole. Interestingly, on a planet like Urantia whose inhabitants are indwelt by Adjusters, a Solitary Messenger feels a qualitative excitation. This suggests that Thought Adjusters are in some manner connected with the Inspired Spirits. Still, they are not the same order: Adjusters come from the Father alone, Inspired Spirits from the Trinity.
p019.s3.b2: The author reports that even as he writes, an Inspired Spirit of the third volume of power presence is with him, not over twenty-five feet away. He goes further, concluding that there is essential spiritual knowledge indispensable to high attainment which cannot be consciously received, and that the Inspired Spirits may be teachers who work by superconscious techniques. The insight that self-consciousness can hinder reception makes us reflect on why the stillness of prayer and meditation matters.
p019.s3.b4: If even high beings cannot see everything, how much more is this true of mortals who are just beginning the journey. So the author commends faith and revelation to us.
p019.s4.h: VI–VII. Havona Natives and Paradise Citizens — Eternal Friends
p019.s4.b0: The Havona natives are perfect beings created directly by the Trinity, and their number and endowments are beyond our imagining. Ascending mortals, passing through the billion worlds of Havona, will form eternal friendships with them. The picture of a deep friendship growing between creatures from the lowest place and natives of the highest is the warmest scene in the paper.
p019.s4.b2: Mortals are compensated for the spiritual impoverishment of their early progress, while the Havoners overcome the experiential handicap of having always lived in perfection. Unlike the Stationary Sons, Havoners can also evolve in status; some fuse with a non-Adjuster Father fragment and join the Mortal Corps of the Finality. Their numbers are therefore slowly diminishing, and the revelators speculate that the future Havona may be peopled by a mixed group of residents.

head: Possible future residents of Havona
Description
rows: Present permanent citizens of the local universe constellations
Beings who may be born on superuniverse spheres in the flowering of light and life
Beings arriving from the successive outer universes

p019.s4.b5: The Paradise Citizens comprise more than three thousand orders of beings; because they are not directly concerned with the ascension scheme, little is revealed about them. The paper closes the story of Trinity-origin beings by noting that none has ever gone astray, though in the highest sense all are freewill endowed. The author adds a homely detail: his journey from Uversa to Urantia took 109 days.
p019.s5.b0: Paper 19 tells of perfect beings, yet unexpectedly it holds up a mirror to us. Perfect wisdom must be paired with the wisdom of experience, and even the Havona natives learn through friendship with ascenders. The way to truth lies in seeing origin, history, and destiny together, and the deepest teaching may come on the quiet level of the superconscious. In a universe where everything changes, God alone is changeless.

head: Practice
The teaching behind it
rows: See myself not only by my past but by the destiny I am called to
The present is truly interpreted only in light of past and future
Do not count the trials I have been through as wasted
Even perfect wisdom needs the wisdom of experience
Make time to set aside words and thoughts and rest in stillness
Some spiritual knowledge cannot be consciously received
Take a step in faith even when I cannot see
Use faith and depend on revelation
Build friendship with people very different from me
Ascenders and Havona natives do great and mutual good

p019.s5.b2: Paper 20 takes up the Paradise Sons of God, and there the story of the Trinity Teacher Sons, set aside in this paper, is told in full.
p020.lead: Creator Michaels, Magisterial Avonals, and Teacher Daynals: the three Paradise Sons who bring the love, mercy, and ministry of Deity down to the worlds of time.

p020.foot.text: Presented by a Perfector of Wisdom from Uversa

p020.s0.h: Introduction — Sons Who Come Down from Heaven
p020.s0.b0: With Paper 20 the book enters the great theme of the “⟦Q 20:0.2⟧Sons of God.⟦/Q⟧” In Orvonton the Sons of God are classified under three heads: descending, ascending, and trinitized. Descending Sons are personalities of direct and divine creation; ascending sons, such as mortals, achieve their status by taking part in evolution; trinitized Sons are a group of composite origin embraced by the Trinity.
p020.s0.b1: All descending Sons have high origins, yet they are devoted to helping lowly evolutionary creatures in their Paradise climb. This paper names seven orders of them and treats in detail the three that come from Paradise.

head: Division
Order of Sons
Known names and roles
rows: Joint offspring of the Creator Son, the Creative Spirit, and Father Melchizedek
The Most Highs, the Constellation Fathers
Brought into being by the Creator Son and Creative Spirit with one of the Ancients of Days

p020.s1.h: I. The Descending Sons of God — Three Origins, One Spirit
p020.s1.b0: The three Paradise Sons differ in origin. Yet the paper stresses their oneness before it stresses their differences.

head: Son
Origin
rows: The Universal Father and the Eternal Son
The Eternal Son and the Infinite Spirit
The Father, the Son, and the Spirit

p020.s1.b3: If the orders of Days are divine administrators, the Paradise Sons are divine ministers: creators, servers, bestowers, judges, teachers, and truth revealers. In a local universe the Magisterial and Teacher Sons serve under the direction of the Creator Son. The Creator Son is personally conscious of every act and emotion of every descending Son serving in his domain, a local universe duplication of the spiritual drawing power of the Eternal Son.
p020.s2.h: II–IV. The Magisterial Sons — Judges and Bestowers
p020.s2.b0: Every time an absolute concept of being formulated by the Eternal Son unites with a new ideal of loving service conceived by the Infinite Spirit, a new Magisterial Son appears. The Avonals number about one billion. They are not creators in the personal sense, but they are closely associated with the Michaels in all their work. Each Avonal has an exclusive personality; no two are alike.

head: Planetary function
How it is carried out
How often
rows: Usually coming as an invisible spirit to end a dispensation and awaken the sleeping survivors
Scores, even hundreds of times on a world
Incarnated as an adult of the realm without mortal birth (the first visit is always material)
Born of woman, living a full mortal life

p020.s2.b2: As dispensational judges the Avonals preside over the awakening of the sleeping survivors, bring an age of suspended justice to an end, and reassign the planetary ministers to the tasks of the new dispensation. But although they may render judgments extinguishing the identity of personal creatures, they do not execute such sentences; that is done only by superuniverse authorities. Once again we see the careful steps through which the Father’s justice passes.
p020.s2.b3: In planetary affairs the Avonals are supported by the full power and authority of their Creator Son, so their service is just as effective as if the Creator Son himself had come. When incarnated on magisterial or bestowal missions they have experienced Adjusters, and these Adjusters are often later personalized to form the supreme Divinington council of direction.
p020.s2.b4: Urantia has never been host to an Avonal on a magisterial mission. In the usual plan one would have come between the days of Adam and the bestowal of Michael, but the final bestowal of our Creator Son wholly deranged that sequence. Urantia is now Michael’s personal ward, and only time can reveal which Sons will come, and when.
p020.s3.h: V–VI. Bestowal — When the Word Is Made Flesh
p020.s3.b0: On Urantia there is a widespread belief that a Son’s bestowal is meant to change the attitude of the Universal Father. The paper corrects this plainly. Bestowal is not appeasing the Father; it is the experiential process through which the Sons become safe and sympathetic rulers of the peoples of time.
p020.s3.b2: Bestowal is also necessary for the planet. Only when a bestowal Son returns to universe headquarters is the Spirit of Truth poured out, and only then do Thought Adjusters come to all normal human beings. The Adjuster within us is thus directly linked to the life of a bestowal Son.
p020.s3.b3: This is also why Urantia draws so much interest in Nebadon. Our small planet matters because it is the mortal home of Jesus of Nazareth, the arena where Michael won supreme sovereignty. Yet the paper adds that no planet could ever require a Creator Son for its rehabilitation; any bestowal Son would have sufficed. It is a balanced view that keeps us humble.
p020.s3.b5: A bestowal Son is always born of woman, grows up as a child, labors like the people of his race, and makes petitions to the Father; the one exception is that he begets no offspring. The revelator urges us not to waste time speculating on how such an incarnation is effected, but to let the knowledge of Jesus’ life sink into our souls.

head: Comparison
Bestowal of a Michael (Creator Son)
Bestowal of an Avonal (Magisterial Son)
rows: “Whosoever has seen the Son has seen the Father”
“Whosoever has seen me has seen the Eternal Son of God”
Son of the Universal Father and the Eternal Son
Not of immediate descent from the Father; bestowed subject to the will of the Eternal Son
The Spirit of Truth of the sovereign Michael
The conjoint Spirit of Truth of the Avonal and the Creator Son (becoming Michael’s spirit after his final bestowal)

p020.s3.b7: A bestowal Son must pass through death and reappears on the third day. But the cruel death Jesus suffered was not a requirement of the divine plan. It made Urantia known as “⟦Q 20:6.6⟧the world of the cross⟦/Q⟧,” while most planets have received their bestowal Sons more considerately. Death is not to satisfy justice or appease wrath; it is the voluntary completion of the bestowal, “⟦Q 20:6.7⟧to drink the cup⟦/Q⟧” of a creature’s life.
p020.s4.h: VII–IX. The Trinity Teacher Sons — Universal Educators
p020.s4.b0: Daynals is their name in Havona; in Orvonton they are Trinity Teacher Sons, and on Salvington they are sometimes called Paradise Spiritual Sons. Their numbers keep growing, now a little more than twenty-one billion. They are neither creators nor judges nor rulers, and they are concerned less with administration than with moral enlightenment and spiritual development.
p020.s4.b2: They receive no preliminary training in the central universe but go directly to the superuniverses, and having no spiritual drawing power of their own, they use the spiritual influence of the Creator and Magisterial Sons. They begin in the local systems and advance through constellation service to the highest work of the local universe; the staff of the University of Salvington alone, including these Sons, numbers over one hundred thousand. They care for the instruction of seraphim as much as for that of ascending mortals.
p020.s4.b4: On the planets the Teacher Sons open a spiritual age. They usually remain a thousand years, one of them presiding over the millennial reign with seventy associates. They do not incarnate but keep contact with the world through the Brilliant Evening Stars. Urantia has never yet known such an age, but even now they visit our world to plan their sojourn, and they will appear when its people have gained comparative deliverance from the shackles of animalism and the fetters of materialism.
p020.s4.b5: This passage leaves a quiet task for our own time. A spiritual age does not simply descend from above; it comes to a world grown ready to receive it. The Teacher Sons neither end dispensations nor judge; they make real the spiritual counterparts of material knowledge. After their final mission, the planet is ushered into light and life.
p020.s5.h: X. United Ministry of the Paradise Sons
p020.s5.b0: The last section draws the work of the three Sons together. All are divine in origin and nature, and all are gifts of the eternal Deities to every creature with ascension potential.

head: Son
Deity natures combined
What is revealed to the local universe
rows: The love of the Father blended with the mercy of the Eternal Son
The infinite character of the Universal Father
The mercy of the Eternal Son united with the ministry of the Infinite Spirit
The matchless nature of the Eternal Son of infinite compassion
The love, mercy, and ministry of all three Deities co-ordinated
The teacher personality of the Infinite Spirit

p020.s5.b3: Together these three Sons help actualize and reveal the personality and sovereignty of God the Supreme in time and space, and they always function in the vanguard as divinity expands without end into the depths of space.
p020.s6.b0: Paper 20 shows that God does not merely command from afar; through his Sons he comes down to live, teach, and judge among us. Bestowal is not a sacrifice to appease the Father’s anger but an experience gained for the sake of understanding and sympathy, and each Son serves his world as though it were the only one. And our own world remains open to a spiritual age that has not yet come.

head: Practice
The teaching behind it
rows: See God as a sympathetic Father rather than a fearsome judge
Bestowal is not meant to change the Father’s attitude
Treat the one person I serve as if he or she were the only one
Each Son serves each world as if he were the only Son of God
Regard ordinary work and labor as holy
Bestowal Sons have followed nearly every vocation
Work at loosening the fetters of materialism

Live as both a learner and a teacher
The Teacher Sons teach even the Sons of God

p020.s6.b2: The Creator Sons, the order of Michael whose story this paper set aside, are taken up fully in Paper 21. It is an important bridge that lets us see the life of Jesus within the larger picture of Michael’s seventh bestowal.
p021.lead: Sons who build and rule the local universes, yet earn their sovereignty by seven times becoming their own creatures: the origin, bestowals, and destiny of the Michaels.

p021.foot.text: Presented by a Perfector of Wisdom from Uversa

p021.s0.h: Introduction — The Son Who Became Our Universe Father
p021.s0.b0: The story of the order of Michael, held back in Paper 20, unfolds in Paper 21. The Creator Sons are the makers and rulers of the local universes of time and space, and they are of dual origin, embodying the characteristics of God the Father and God the Son. Yet each differs from every other; each is unique in nature as well as in personality, the “only-begotten Son” of his own origin. The one we know as Jesus is one of this order, Michael of Nebadon.
p021.s0.b1: From its opening the paper stresses how warm the relationship is between the Creator Sons and the Father. Throughout the long work of building and perfecting a local universe, these Sons enjoy the Father’s sustaining approval. And that love is linked to the love found in our own homes.
p021.s0.b3: The name Michael comes from the first Son of this order. The original Michael never incarnated as a material being, but seven times he passed through the experience of spiritual creature ascent on the seven circuits of Havona. So the order of Michael knows the grand universe from one end to the other.
p021.s1.h: I. Origin and Nature of Creator Sons — The Only-Begotten of Two Infinite Minds
p021.s1.b0: When the fullness of absolute spiritual ideation in the Eternal Son encounters the fullness of absolute personality concept in the Universal Father, a new Creator Son flashes into full-fledged being. He is the only Son that particular union could ever produce, the complete expression of every possibility of the divine potentials that brought him forth. There never can be another like him.
p021.s1.b1: So some Michaels appear more like the Father, some more like the Son, and some equally like both. The trend of administration in Nebadon suggests that our Creator Son more resembles the Eternal Mother Son. The revelator adds that this is no criticism, simply a record of fact. The Creator Sons appear to number more than seven hundred thousand, and their number keeps growing.
p021.s1.b2: This uniqueness spreads through the whole universe. Because each Michael is the architect of the life plans of his realm, no two local universes have identical native beings. Half of a native creature’s inherent attributes come from the uniform Creative Spirits, and the other half from the diversified Creator Sons. Diversity is not a defect; it is God’s way of creating.
p021.s2.h: II. The Creators of Local Universes — Freedom and Its Limits
p021.s2.b0: A Creator Son chooses the space site of his universe himself, but first he must spend a long time observing the work of his older brothers in the same superuniverse, and before that he completes his Paradise observation and Havona training. It is striking that even a Creator learns before he creates. When he leaves Paradise, he is accompanied by a Creative Daughter of the Infinite Spirit, the future Mother Spirit of his universe.
p021.s2.b1: His creator prerogatives are wide, but not unlimited. Certain things remain with the Paradise Sources and Centers.

p021.s2.b3: When Michael is absent, the Bright and Morning Star directs the government, and the Mother Spirit remains at headquarters, extending her care to the uttermost parts of the universe. Even without the Creator Son the material universe runs on, for no material organization is independent of the absolute-gravity grasp of Paradise and the overcontrol of the Unqualified Absolute.
p021.s3.h: III. Local Universe Sovereignty — Authority Earned, Not Seized
p021.s3.b0: Sovereignty is the heart of this paper. A Creator Son receives his universe by the consent of the Trinity and the confirmation of the Master Spirit, but this is only a kind of “cosmic leasehold.” He could assert full sovereignty from the start, but he wisely chooses not to. He elects to earn it through the experience of bestowal, and until then he rules as vicegerent of the Universal Father.
p021.s3.b2: So Michael takes an oath to the Trinity not to assume supreme sovereignty until his seven bestowals are complete. If he could not do otherwise, the oath would have no meaning. The sight of one who holds power deferring it of his own accord, and qualifying himself through service, shows what true authority is.

p021.s3.b4: In a universe without rebellion the limits of prebestowal sovereignty never show; in a universe with rebellion they do. If his authority is challenged, the Creator Son is eternally pledged to uphold and, if necessary, retrieve his creation. He can be troubled only by creatures of his own making or by higher beings of his own choosing.
p021.s3.b6: The technique of earning supreme sovereignty is to experience seven creature levels by incarnation, each time consecrating himself to one phase of the sevenfold will of Deity personified in the Seven Master Spirits, and to unify the two. In this way the Creator Son not only proves his fitness to rule but reveals the nature of Deity. The creature’s grasp of the Father’s primacy is bound up with the Creator’s adventure in condescending to take the form of his creatures.
p021.s4.h: IV. The Michael Bestowals — What “It Is Finished” Means
p021.s4.b0: Avonal bestowals are always in the likeness of mortal flesh, but the seven bestowals of a Michael span seven creature levels. The final one is always a mortal bestowal, usually as a member of the race carrying the largest legacy of Adamic stock. Only once in his sevenfold career is a Michael born of woman, and only once does he live and die as the lowest order of will creature.
p021.s4.b1: After each bestowal he goes to the “⟦Q 21:4.4⟧right hand of the Father⟦/Q⟧” to gain acceptance and prepare for the next. The Michael who came to Urantia had already completed six phases. So when he gave up his incarnated life and said, “⟦Q 21:4.5⟧It is finished⟦/Q⟧,” it was literally finished. His death completed his bestowal career, and from then on he rules not as a vicegerent but in his own right as “⟦Q 21:4.5⟧King of Kings and Lord of Lords.⟦/Q⟧”
p021.s4.b2: A Creator Son who has completed his bestowals is reckoned a separate order, a sevenfold Master Son. He is still a Creator, but he has added the experience of a creature to his nature. Here the revelator speaks to us directly: if even the Gods must pass through experience before they are fully qualified to rule, we have no reason to lament our own humble beginnings.
p021.s5.h: V. Relation of Master Sons to the Universe
p021.s5.b0: The power of a Master Michael is unlimited because it comes from experienced association with the Trinity, and unquestioned because it comes from actual experience as one of the creatures subject to his authority. His sovereignty is supreme for three reasons.

head: Ground of supreme sovereignty
Meaning
rows: It embraces the sevenfold viewpoint of Paradise Deity
It embodies a sevenfold attitude of time-space creatures
The viewpoints of Creator and creature become one

p021.s5.b2: Upon attaining supreme sovereignty, Michael gives up the power to create entirely new types of beings in the present age. Instead he devotes himself personally to fostering and administering what has already been made. From this point the long uncertainty and confusion begin to end. It is worth noting that justice prevails only after endless mercy and patience have been exhausted.
p021.s5.b4: A Master Son makes and carries out plans of his own choosing for the worlds of his sojourn, and above all for the planet where he incarnated in mortal flesh. He keeps in touch with those worlds through the Spirit of Truth, which he “pours out upon all flesh.” The Spirit of Truth at work in each of us is the spiritual presence of this sovereign Michael.
p021.s6.h: VI. Destiny of the Master Michaels — The Way, the Truth, and the Life
p021.s6.b0: No one can speak with final authority about the destiny of the Master Sons. The revelators can only speculate that each Michael is the absolute of the dual deity concepts of his origin, holding superfinite capacities not yet revealed. The restriction on creating new types of beings seems connected with the liberation of this potential.
p021.s6.b1: In the far future, in the universes of outer space, the liaison of a sevenfold Master Son and a seventh-stage Creative Spirit may bring forth new meanings and values. The seventh career of the Mother Spirit we met in Paper 17 here meets the future of Michael. Just as the Supreme is actualizing through experiential service, the Creator Sons are realizing the divine potentials bound up in their natures.
p021.s6.b3: The revelators believe that in eternity the Michaels are literally destined to be “⟦Q 21:6.4⟧the way, the truth, and the life,⟦/Q⟧” ever blazing the path for all universe personalities toward eternal deity finality. It is an ending that shows these words of Jesus to be more than the confession of one planet; they are a universal promise.
p021.s7.b0: Paper 21 tells us who the Creator of our universe is. He had all power from the beginning, yet he did not seize it; seven times he became one of his creatures and earned his sovereignty through understanding and sympathy. His final bestowal was Jesus on Urantia. After reading this paper, the life of Jesus appears anew as the event that completed the history of an entire local universe.

p021.s7.b2: With Paper 21 the main account of the Paradise Sons is complete, and the papers that follow turn to the Trinitized Sons of God (Paper 22) and the family of the Infinite Spirit. If we keep in mind the Michael we have met here, we will sense that the whole story of the local universe that follows unfolds under the care of a fatherly Son.
